description: Generates a delayed pulse at the output when triggered by a rising edge. Delay duration is provided via input.

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: Trigger signal. A rising edge starts the delayed pulse sequence.

inputs.name: Delay
inputs.description: Delay duration in seconds before the output pulse. 0 means immediate pulse.

outputs.name: Output
outputs.description: Pulse signal. Goes high after the delay and stays high for the configured pulse duration.

config.name: Duration of output pulse
config.description: Duration of the output pulse generated after the delay.

state.name: Last input state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the input to detect rising edges.
